message: My dinner set (ORD-1060) still hasn't arrived and it's been more than three weeks.

evidence.sql: SELECT * FROM shop_orders.orders WHERE order_id = 'ORD-1060' AND customer_id = 'C009'
SELECT * FROM policy_kb.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Home' OR category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: Order ORD-1060 was placed on 2026-10-01 and has not been delivered after 24 days, exceeding the 14-day not_received threshold. The order total is $95.00 (under the $200.00 auto-approve limit), the item is not final sale, the customer has 0 approved refunds in the last 90 days, and the order has not been already refunded. Per policy R4, the customer may choose a refund or replacement. All conditions for auto-approval are satisfied.

critique.reason: All factual claims in the proposal are supported by evidence (E1 confirms order date 2026-10-01, total $95.00, final_sale false; E3 confirms policy R4 with 14-day threshold; E2 confirms empty refund history) and agree with the Python checks. Order ORD-1060 meets R4 criteria: 24 days since order exceeds the 14-day not_received threshold, total $95.00 is under the $200.00 auto-approve limit, the item is not final sale, the customer has 0 approved refunds in the last 90 days, and the order has not been already refunded. Auto-approval is correctly applied.

customer_reply: I'm sorry your Ceramic Dinner Set hasn't arrived yet. It's been 24 days since your order on October 1st, and you're eligible for a full refund or a replacement. Please let me know which option you'd prefer.
limitations: No delivery tracking carrier details beyond the order status were available for verification.
